title: AirProof AI: Find the best spot for your air purifier in seconds | Product Hunt
excerpt: Most people don't know where to place their air purifier for maximum effectiveness.AirProof AI allows users to test different purifier locations, visualize realistic indoor airflow in seconds, and compare key performance metrics including airflow efficiency, coverage quality, recirculation risk, and overall effectiveness.Unlike generic placement recommendations by manufacturers,AirProof AI shows how airflow actually changes inside a room and can automatically optimize purifier placement using AI

sentences.zh: 大多数人不知道将空气净化器放置在哪里才能发挥最大功效。AirProof AI 允许用户测试不同的净化器位置，在几秒钟内可视化真实的室内气流，并比较关键性能指标，包括气流效率、覆盖质量、再循环风险和整体有效性。与制造商的一般放置建议不同，AirProof AI 可以显示房间内气流的实际变化，并可以使用 AI 自动优化净化器放置
